description: Checks whether a type exists in the SAP Data Dictionary and returns its kind. Returns type_kind: TABL (transparent/cluster/pool table — queryable), STRU (structure — NOT queryable, cannot SELECT from it), VIEW (database view — queryable), DTEL (data element), TTYP (table type), BUILTIN, TYPEPOOL. Use this to verify whether an object is a real database table before attempting sap_read_table_data or sap_count_rows.
name: sap_check_type_exists
